author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
You reported the bugs, and I got to work. This month's Windows Utility update focuses on fixes, polish, and improvements driven by your feedback.

We cover WinUtil and Win One Shot updates, including clipboard and run history fixes, better display scaling, expanded language support, and a reworked Windows 11 Creator. I also share why I scrapped a month of development when it made the tool slower.

What should I tackle next? Share your feedback in the comments!
Thanks to General Translation for sponsoring this video.
